Dryasons are a race in the world of Sword x Staff, known for their signature rabbit or foxlike ears. One exception to this, however, is [[Molly]], who has two hairbuns where her ears should be. This makes it unclear if all dryasons have animal ears, or if she is truly a dryason.<gallery>
